meta.source: Mockup prompt palette (2026-09-23) + six approved Manus screens

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. The auroras sit on it; glass surfaces sit on top.

tokens.name: aurora-indigo
tokens.usage: Decorative light beam behind main areas only, blurred 120–160px at 18–28% opacity. Never text, never a fill with content on it.

tokens.name: aurora-violet
tokens.usage: Decorative light beam, same rules as aurora-indigo.

tokens.name: aurora-teal
tokens.usage: Decorative light beam, used sparingly (one per screen at most).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default glass surface: panels, header, cards with little text. Always with backdrop blur and glass-border.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Glass for surfaces carrying a lot of text (asset cards, summary panel) and for inputs, so text never sits on a busy aurora.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of every glass surface, input and secondary button.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Top edge highlight of glass panels (fades to transparent within 40% of the height).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on bg, glass and glass-strong (≥15:1 on bg).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, labels, notes, on bg, glass and glass-strong (≈8.7:1 on bg).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels and dividers' captions only. ≈4.2:1 on bg — below 4.5:1, so never for information a person must read (kept exact from the source).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand indigo as text and marks: links, active step, focus ring, first composition segment. On bg and glass (≈6.2:1).

tokens.name: primary-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button (Connect wallet, Interpret, Invest). Text on it is on-primary (≈4.8:1).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind primary text: current step halo, selected chip, EXAMPLE badge.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Valid, confirmed, available (Valid pill, Buy ✓, completed step). As text on bg, glass or accent-soft (≈10:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of valid/available pills and chips.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Limitations and attention: no route, unallocated weight, partial representation. As text on bg, glass or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning pills and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Invalid and blocked: weight above the limit, total over 100%. As text on bg, glass or danger-soft (≈7:1). Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger pills, invalid inputs and notices.

tokens.name: seg-1
tokens.usage: Composition bar, first asset segment.

tokens.name: seg-2
tokens.usage: Composition bar, second asset segment (blue, as in the approved composition screen).

tokens.name: seg-3
tokens.usage: Composition bar, third asset segment.

tokens.name: seg-4
tokens.usage: Composition bar, fourth segment (the USDC share in the reference). Segments are always labelled in the legend — never told apart by color alone.

tokens.name: seg-track
tokens.usage: Empty track of the composition bar and of weight bars: the unallocated share.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one question of the Discovery screen. Once per product.

styles.name: title-1
styles.sample: How this thesis can be represented
styles.usage: Page title of a step (Interpretation, Composition, Position).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Panel headline: empty and loading states.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles: asset, thesis, panel sections.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Describe a belief. We show how it can be represented.
styles.usage: Subtitles under display and title-1, in text-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The largest link in AI's physical supply chain.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Not your balance — it's how much you plan to allocate.
styles.usage: Notes, reasons under disabled buttons, chip labels. Never smaller than 13px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels and the EXAMPLE badge.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Budget and composition total. Tabular figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Weights, amounts, mints and any number in a row. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the page title block and content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of page under the header.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles inside buttons, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards (asset, thesis) and icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels: header bar, summary panel, empty/loading panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, status pills, composition bar.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass panel and card.

tokens.name: shadow-primary-glow
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest and the active progress step; nothing else glows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in bg, then a solid 2px primary ring (≥3:1 on bg and glass).

blur.note: Backdrop blur for glass and the aurora beams.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of glass surfaces, with saturate(140%).

tokens.name: blur-aurora
tokens.usage: Filter blur of the aurora beams (120–160px range).

tokens.name: opacity-aurora
tokens.usage: Aurora beams (18–28% range).

tokens.name: opacity-rejected
tokens.usage: A rejected asset card, except its Undo control.
